en.title: H.L.D.P.K
en.decryption: Symbols of Buddha's life: Horse (Departure), Lotus/Bull (Birth), Dharma Chakra (First Sermon), Pipal/Bodhi Tree (Enlightenment), Lion/Stupa (Death/Nirvana).
